ITEM 2 | Golden-brown roasted cubes, about 2-3 cm, with browned, slightly charred edges, crisp-looking exterior and pale cream interior, some pieces glistening lightly with oil, lying in a cluster on the left side of the plate | 110

ITEM 4 | Reddish-brown thin sauce or gravy with a smooth, slightly glossy surface and some darker specks, pooled on a separate white plate at the far left edge of the image, flowing and liquid | 60
